predecessors.name: Haiti
predecessors.text: the whole Haitian state, held by the United States as an occupation from 28 July 1915 to 1 August 1934 (infobox) and independent again from 15 August 1934

ledger.x: 1936: Cliopatria's Republic of Haiti row begins on the land of its earlier Haiti rows; one state, not a founding.
